en: The postcard features a monochrome architectural drawing of a large religious complex on a hill. The most prominent building is a massive domed basilica with classical architectural features, flanked by smaller institutional buildings and towers. The image has a caption in Dutch and an artist's signature in the lower right corner. Below the image is a printed text, and faint handwritten text is visible at the bottom.
